scope: Original M1 cached frozen RPN detections -> fixed existing ByteTrack CPU-only bounded physical comparison; not main qualification, all-Val, semantic feedback/training, M9 or policy scope extension
candidate: Retained native RPN/ROI det_boxes/det_score -> exact existing NumPy/SciPy class-agnostic ByteTrack; no new detector/weights or pixel inference
selection: First four ascending Val video IDs; first at most16 image metadata rows by frame_index/image_id, no category/annotation inspection or substitution
comparison: All4 fixed sources: new RPN/ByteTrack, retained RPN/MASA, PANDAS/ByteTrack and weak SAM-grid/MASA. Old3 metrics/coverage/purity exactly reproduced, identical clippedGT hash before acceptance.
sampling_boundary: Both native and new route reset at first of same16 annotated images with ordinal cadence/no prehistory. Existing ByteTrack buffer30/frame_rate30 ->30annotated-step lost horizon, not dense30fps calendar time/nativeMASA memo10. PANDAS retains different detector/dense-frame history. No isolated threshold/window/architecture causal attribution.
provenance_boundary: Published generic-image route supported; exact released SAM-B training stage config/data ledger missing. Diagnostic is not supervision certification.
quality_contract: Unchanged raw RPN/ROI one-class foreground probability det_score in [0,1]; no sigmoid/clamp/normalization/calibration/NMS/cap added by wrapper. Existing ByteTrack built-in fixed gates/minarea and Kalman boxes preserved.

evaluation.coverage: Fixed class-free temporal-IoU>=0.5 Hungarian on entire selected-clip Known/Novel GT universe; all predictions retained
evaluation.hota: Existing pinned TAO_OW adapter SUBSET=all/MAX_DETECTIONS=300, unchanged preprocessing; identical clipped GT for both streams
evaluation.lengths: Native annotated-cadence lengths and PANDAS annotated projection lengths only; not full-video lifetime lengths
evaluation.purity: Per-frame geometric match first; categories/identity mixing aggregate only after prediction sealing. Unknown unmatched rows not declared background/pure.

stop_rules: No detector/tracker training, score repair, threshold/buffer/IoU/NMS/cap search or alternate source
Full fixed64production frames including empty frames must seal before evaluator GT; no resampling for Novel targets
Preserve partial/failed runs; no automatic repeat/full-Val/cache or qualification
No GT-policy expansion, R2, semantic M11 feedback or Test
publish: Aggregate physical metrics/counts/coverage/pollution/lengths/hashes/resources only; raw NPZ and clipped GT stay private; small-sample zeroNovel2 cannot establish full-Val quality
model_view: Current anonymous boxes/foreground probabilities only. Ordinal determined by sequential calls; no future/current GT, category, native track ID/box, embedding, prototype or semantic input.
causality_probe: First4 source frames of first registered video,2 replays; same first2 detections, shift only future2 boxes by fixed[1000,1000,1000,1000], scores unchanged. Exact prefix first2 physical output hashes after per-video reset; never GT-evaluate probe outputs.
